title: Silver Zoom Card: Adding Fleet Drivers to Your Account
summary: Explains how to add fleet drivers to a Silver Zoom Card account, including checking the total requested employee cards is within the account cap of 60, adding driver details in the account management portal, assigning role permissions, and monitoring activation/receipt. Also covers best practices like maintaining an active roster and deactivating cards when access is no longer needed.
faqs: What do I need to confirm before adding fleet drivers to my Silver Zoom Card account?
